in_marathi.name: Amarnath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amarnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amarnath is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amara', which means 'Immortal'. In Hindu mythology, Amarnath is the name of a god, Lord Shiva, who is believed to reside in the Amarnath Cave in the Himalayas. The name holds deep spiritual significance and is often used as a name for baby boys in Hindu communities.
